name: Piecewise Linear Opacity Mapping with Gradient Scaling
definition: A volume rendering technique that maps voxel values to opacity using piecewise linear functions defined by tissue types, then scales the resulting opacity by the magnitude of the local gradient vector to suppress tissue interiors and enhance bounding surfaces.
summary: Piecewise Linear Opacity Mapping with Gradient Scaling enhances volume rendering edges by scaling tissue-based opacity with local gradient magnitude, suppressing interiors and preserving thin structures.
